deities: Lord Ganesha (five/six rock-cut Ganesha idols said to represent the Pandavas - sources disagree on five vs six; one also mentions a sacred Vishnu Shila)

history.dynasty: None documented (pre-Ahom site; one visitor review claims Ahom king Rajeswar Singha built and gifted the devalaya - weakly sourced)
history.summary: IDENTITY FLAG: the CSV name 'Pandu Temple' is generic and matches no single canonical listing; this file documents the most likely referent, the Pandunath Temple (Pandunath Devalaya, also called the Pancha Pandav Temple) in the Tilla Hills of Pandu, Guwahati - the temple after which the entire Pandu locality is named (per Wikipedia's Pandu article). An alternate candidate exists on listing sites as 'Pandu Temple Ghat Shiva Temple', so the mapping remains provisional. Local belief holds that the Pandavas and Draupadi stayed here during their exile and that the rock-cut Ganesha idols represent them in disguise; visitors also cite rock inscriptions and artefacts, but most accounts say practically nothing remains of the old temple structure and that the site is being encroached, urging ASI intervention. The temple stands on the banks of the Brahmaputra near Pandu Ghat, adjacent to the Nilachal Hills.

name: Pandunath Temple
town_description: Pandu is a locality in western Guwahati on the banks of the Brahmaputra, named after the Pandunath Temple in its Tilla Hills. It hosts the Pandu Port, a major hub of river transport managed by the Inland Waterways Authority of India, and sits just north of Maligaon.

travel.airport: Lokpriya Gopinath Bordoloi International Airport - about 12 km (verify).
travel.railway: Kamakhya station is the nearest; Guwahati Junction about 8 km (verify).
travel.road: On Pandu Road, Maligaon, near Pandu Railway Station and Pandu Ghat; reachable by auto/taxi from Guwahati city.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; the riverside setting is pleasant in winter.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Not widely documented (verify). Approach roads and facilities are basic per visitor reviews.
